visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a large white title overlay '臺灣 Taiwan' over a high-contrast shot of a deep, rocky canyon. A lone person stands on the boulder-strewn ground under a narrow sliver of bright sky. (2) In Kaohsiung's Dona canyon, a woman wearing a red bikini walks into a clear turquoise pool near a waterfall. A man in blue swim trunks stands nearby, holding a smartphone or drone controller while looking at the water. (3) The camera pans upward from the narrow canyon floor toward the bright, overexposed sky visible between the dark, towering rock faces. The texture of the damp, layered stone is visible. (4) In Nantou's Wujie, a drone shot looks down into a wider canyon with a river flowing through it. Hikers are visible on the rocky banks surrounded by lush green mountainside vegetation. A woman in hiking shorts and a sun hat walks through the shallow stream. (5) In Changhua, a woman in a white t-shirt and dark leggings hikes through a extremely narrow, moss-covered crevice in the rocks. She uses trekking poles and touches the damp walls, looking up in awe. (6) In Tainan's Meiling, multiple hikers are seen climbing and descending a very steep, narrow fissure in the rock using installed ropes. The lighting is dim inside the crevice with bright light at the top opening.

A faint, low-frequency ambient bed of flowing water is audible in the background mix. (2) As the acoustic arrangement continues with a steady rhythmic pulse, the sounds of nature remain consistent. Subtle incidental noises, such as soft splashing and footsteps on rocks, are delicately mixed beneath the dominant musical track. There are no human voices. (3) The acoustic BGM maintains its tempo and spectral brightness through the remainder of the clip. The production is clean, with a high signal-to-noise ratio, focusing entirely on the harmonious blend of instruments and the peaceful environmental atmosphere of the outdoor scenes.
